text: Sheaf semantics for constructive logic uses: a proposition P is valid iff it holds 'locally' meaning:
choices: P is true in the terminal sheaf
P is in the global sections of the sheaf associated to P
P is forced at all points of the underlying space
P has a section over every open covering
explanation: Sheaf semantics for intuitionistic logic: a proposition P is locally true if it has sections over open covers. This gives Kripke-like semantics with a topological flavour.
